name: Rekkiad
description: Rekkiad was a planet in the remote Rekkiad system, located in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. A desolate world covered in ice and snow, it was where the Jedi Knights Revan and Malak hid Mandalore's Mask following the Mandalorian Wars.
lead_paragraphs: Rekkiad was a planet in the remote Rekkiad system, located in the Outer Rim region of the galaxy. A desolate world covered in ice and snow, it was where the Jedi Knights Revan and Malak hid Mandalore's Mask following the Mandalorian Wars.
